recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source edit is needed for FHIR-14550; preserve the separate audit trail for FHIR-14551 and FHIR-17170 rather than folding adjacent REST or fullUrl wording decisions into this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-14550 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I FHIR-core change request asking to remove optionality for Bundle.entry.request in transaction and batch Bundle entries, enforce the rule with an invariant, and stop requiring servers to infer create/update intent from a missing request.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 13906, represented in git by c613b68f9b76a6d4f114766f447107ba47643a62. That GF#14550 commit changed the historical Bundle spreadsheet invariant so request was mandatory for batch/transaction/history and removed the no-request inference wording from the Bundle transaction/batch narrative. The old spreadsheet source was later refactored into source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml includes both the Bundle resource page and source/http.html. Later FHIR-38942 source history split the old Bundle request/response invariant into bdl-3a through bdl-3d while preserving the transaction/batch request requirement as bdl-3c. Related FHIR-14551 already audits the REST batch/transaction paragraph, and related FHIR-17170 already audits the fullUrl wording that FHIR-14550 identified as separate related work.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml has bdl-3c requiring transaction and batch entries to have request.method, which enforces Bundle.entry.request and an explicit HTTP method. Current source/http.html says each batch/transaction entry SHALL carry Bundle.entry.request details, and the current transaction/batch Bundle profiles require Bundle.entry.request in each method slice.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the RESTful API batch/transaction paragraph using the mandatory-request decision from FHIR-14550 and is already represented on the combined branch.
Clarified the transaction/batch fullUrl wording that FHIR-14550 called out as related work and is already represented on the combined branch.
Refactored Bundle invariants into bdl-3a through bdl-3d while preserving the transaction/batch request requirement in bdl-3c.
